description_en: Queries the certificate list of a cloud service instance. This operation returns the certificate list of the current delegated administrator and the user who owns the instance. This operation is used only in multi-account scenarios. For example, if user A is the delegated administrator and has certificate cert1, and cloud service instance lb-xx-1 belongs to member user B and has certificate cert2, when you query instance lb-xx-1, the operation returns both cert1 and cert2
description_zh: 查询云产品实例的证书列表。该接口返回当前委派管理员和实例所属用户的证书列表，该接口仅在多账号场景下使用。如：用户A是委派管控员，有证书cert1，云产品实例lb-xx-1是成员用户B，有证书cert2，查询实例lb-xx-1时，接口返回cert1和cert2
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-resource-instance-certs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-0 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeResourceInstanceCerts

parameters.help_en: The page number to return in a paged query. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10, which indicates 10 entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为10，表示每页包含10条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The WAF instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

AfterDate.description_en: The expiration time of the certificate. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
AfterDate.description_zh: 证书到期时间。Unix 时间戳格式，单位：毫秒（ms）

BeforeDate.description_en: The issuance time of the certificate. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
BeforeDate.description_zh: 证书的签发时间。Unix 时间戳格式，单位：毫秒（ms）

CertIdentifier.description_en: The global certificate ID, which is in the format of certificate ID + "-cn-hangzhou". For example, if the certificate ID is 123, the CertIdentifier is "123-cn-hangzhou"

Domain.description_en: The domain name supported by the certificate

IsChainCompleted.description_en: Indicates whether the certificate chain is complete

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
